messages:
Maya Lee: Quick heads-up — prepping cost section for ACME QBR (Thu). Saw a spike in embed usage last week: +48% tokens vs forecast. Need a short blurb on cause + mitigation. Who can pull a 7-day token trend?
Frank O'Connor: I'm on it. Renewal team pinged last week — potential downgrade if spend keeps climbing. Can we get a per-route breakdown? cc @Olivia Chen :eyes:
Olivia Chen: Pulling numbers now. Preliminary: overall tokens +48%, but ~70% of the delta is from /embed route (nightly-indexer cron). 30-day forecast at current rate ≈ $18.2k/mo vs baseline $7.4k. Suggest temporary rate limit + token sampling. Will attach CSV.
Liam Patel: The indexer uses d-embed-xl and large context windows. Options: 1) re-quantize model to 8-bit (≈35% savings), 2) reduce context window / stride batches. Both ~2-3h dev. Quick win: route non-critical docs to d-embed-medium — ~50% cost cut, small accuracy loss.
Maya Lee: Can we run an A/B canary: route 20% traffic to medium, measure quality delta? Need results by Wed EOD.
OnboardBot: ALERT: Account ACME crossed budget threshold (retainer). threshold=USD 10,000, used=USD 12,450. (generated 2025-11-02T09:12:07Z)
Olivia Chen: Shared forecast + one-liner calc in internal docs: `SELECT date, tokens, cost FROM billing.tokens WHERE account=\'acme\' AND date >= \'2025-10-01\'` — I'll attach the CSV to ticket CS-4721.
Nina (DevEx): I can draft a 1-pager for their SREs: code samples to switch to batched smaller-context embeddings + quantization flags. Draft by tomorrow.
Maya Lee: Action items:
- Liam + Nina: implement 20% traffic switch canary -> deploy by Tue.
- Olivia: finalize forecast + churn-risk blurb for renewal packet.
- Frank: prep renewal talking points (safety nets, credits offer).
I'll assemble QBR cost slide once we have canary metrics.
Frank O'Connor: I'll flag renewal as "watch" with AE leadership. If canary stabilizes costs, propose 6-week credits instead of a straight discount.
Maya Lee: Thanks all :thumbsup: Drop blockers here. Also need to capture customer feedback — Olivia, can you ask ACME for the indexer run window (exact timestamps) so we can correlate spikes?
Olivia Chen: Yep, I'll request run window in the onboarding ticket and paste reply here.
